it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e assumiu a prefeitura depois que Karime Fayad renunciou ao cargo para disputar a eleição de 2026 para deputada federal. A posse, em sessão solene da Câmara Municipal no Casarão Furquim, foi marcada para 04/04/2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and became mayor after Mayor Karime Fayad resigned to run for federal deputy in the 2026 election. The swearing-in, in a formal session of the City Council at the Casarão Furquim, was scheduled for April 4, 2026.
